name: Calzada de Calatrava (Spain)
description: Vertically divided white and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Calzada de Calatrava (a castle on blue and a cross of Calatrava above a road).
history: Municipal flag of Calzada de Calatrava; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Calzada de Calatrava arms — castle and cross of Calatrava above a road
